A black rubber tire surrounds the rim, showing tread patterns on the top and sidewall details. The background includes part of the white car body and fender.

The boundary between the rubber tire bead and the metal rim lip is slightly soft and lacks the precise, hard-edge contact shadow expected in a high-resolution macro shot. It looks slightly fused.
The lug nuts are not perfectly uniform circles; they appear slightly distorted or irregular in shape, which is a common AI generation artifact when rendering small, repetitive mechanical parts.
